name: Ignite employment and education program (paid internships)
what_you_do: Youth make a plan with a case manager for school, GED, college or certificates. Then they do four weeks of job workshops, then an eight week paid internship with a local employer.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 14 to 26 who have no home or an unsafe home and are signed up with Ignite. The page does not say how to sign up.
pay_detail: Paid internships. The pay rate is not stated.
duration: 4 weeks of workshops, then 8 weeks of internship
how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 line at 866-803-8336, text 312-625-1858, or call the office at 312-568-5700. Drop-in center: 56 E 47th Street, Suite 410-C, Chicago.
notes: For teens who have no stable home. Pay, start dates and who qualifies are not stated on the page, so call first. If you are in danger right now, call 911.
